prompt.project_info: A soft cinematic fine-art vintage portrait with nostalgic, emotional, hazy, poetic motion.
prompt.main_subject: Young woman with light golden hair in motion, a calm expression, soft eyes, parted lips, and flowing hair strands.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical soft-focus portrait at a window, with slight blur and a ghost effect across the face and hair. Isolate the subject against a creamy background with shallow depth of field.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural window light creates a soft glow on skin and hair. Use warm golden beige and sepia tones, cinematic warmth, low clarity, and a nostalgic dreamy atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Canon EOS R5, 85mm lens at f/1.2, ISO 320, slow shutter for intentional motion blur, 4K output, cinematic color grade.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Soft cinematic portrait of a young woman with light golden hair in motion. Slight blur and ghost effect, hair flowing, dreamy look. Calm expression, soft eyes, parted lips. Warm golden beige and sepia tones, nostalgic mood. Natural window light, soft glow on skin. Shot on Canon EOS R5, 85mm lens, f/1.2, ISO 320, slow shutter for motion blur. Soft focus, shallow depth, creamy background. Cinematic color grade, warm tones, low clarity. Emotional, hazy, poetic, fine art vintage style, 4K.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, readable text, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No reference asset is required. If an approved person or location reference is attached, preserve the supplied identity where appropriate, light golden hair, window position, soft ghosted motion, creamy background, and warm sepia palette. Exact facial features and motion pattern may otherwise be replaced.
